name: 06001 · Avon, CT
findings: ZIP 06001 (Avon) has 102 nonprofit organizations. 49 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 41 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06001 (Avon) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 06001 (Avon) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.
